payload.text: **Pre-notice additions (todo 74), 2026-09-19:** (1) 0093: lib/cmd/doctor runs every executable in a project's bin/.devbin/cmd/doctor.d/ after its own checks, and 'doctor <check>' runs one; a project whose cmd/doctor.d/ holds anything will see it run. (2) WP-06: release's cut runs all eleven steps (object: ci, after:, ci.query), bounded after the push. (3) The test helper's two guards are devbin's own tests, not vendored: no pre-notice. (4) 0092 is devbin's own test handler, not vendored: no pre-notice.
